title: CORR-001: Fix race condition in pagination watcher
description: The watcher on `page` will trigger fetchUsers() without checking if a fetch is already in progress. This can cause multiple concurrent requests if user clicks pagination rapidly, resulting in stale data overwriting newer responses and inconsistent UI state.

context.issue: No concurrency guard; rapid pagination clicks trigger multiple simultaneous requests

acceptance_criteria: Pagination watcher checks loading.value before calling fetchUsers()
User can click pagination buttons rapidly without triggering concurrent requests
Verify with devtools Network tab: only one /api/users request in flight at any time
Verify UI always shows most recent data, not stale data
Page indicator and row display match the loaded data
Loading indicator shows only once per page change

implementation_notes.loading_state: Ensure loading.value is set to true at start of fetchUsers() and false at end (in finally block)
implementation_notes.comparison: Jobs.vue:260-268 uses onFilterChange() -> page reset -> load() pattern with built-in loading guard
implementation_notes.no_external_deps: Uses existing loading ref, no new dependencies needed

unit_test: Mock fetchUsers() and verify it's called only once per watch trigger
manual_test: Click pagination buttons 3-4 times in rapid succession (within 1 second)
Watch DevTools Network tab: only one /api/users request should be in flight
Verify page number matches displayed users
Try with delay: click page 2, immediately click page 3 before request completes
Verify final result shows page 3 users, not page 2
stress_test: Use browser DevTools to slow down network (throttle to slow 3G)
Rapidly click pagination buttons while request is in-flight
Verify no duplicate or overlapping requests

rollback_plan: git revert <commit-hash> — isolated change, safe to revert
notes: This is a correctness fix preventing data inconsistency. Must be fixed before merge. The loading state must be properly maintained in fetchUsers() for this guard to work correctly.
